newsitem.title: USA: Gymboree Nov same-store sales fell 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Gymboree Nov same-store sales fell 15 pct.

text.p: The Gymboree Corp said Thursday it had sales for the four week period ended December 1, 1996 of $31.3 million, an increase of 6 percent from sales of $29.6 million for the four week period ended December 3, 1995. Comparable store sales for the four week period decreased 15 percent compared to the same period last year.
Net Sales for the 43 weeks ended December 1, 1996, were $243.0 million, an increase of 15 percent from sales of $211.4 million for the same period ended December 3, 1995.
Comparable store sales for the 43 week period decreased 9 percent compared to last year.
